```{r module-6-pricing-optimisation, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# Select uniform and targeted premiums using fitted conversion probabilities.
# Enforce rate-level, contribution and claims-ratio constraints; assess fixed decisions using DGP probabilities.

required_packages <- c( "tidyverse", "mgcv", "lpSolve" )
missing_packages <- required_packages[ !required_packages %in% rownames( installed.packages() ) ]
if ( length( missing_packages ) > 0L
) {
  stop( paste0( "Install the following packages before running Module 6: ", paste( missing_packages,
        collapse = ", " ) ) )
}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(mgcv)
  library(lpSolve)
})
options( dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE, scipen = 999 )
config <- list( seed = 20260817L,
  conversion_model_dir = file.path("outputs", "conversion_models"),
  quote_market_dir = file.path("outputs", "quote_market"),
  conversion_generation_dir = file.path("outputs", "conversion_generation"),
  output_dir = file.path("outputs", "pricing_simulation"),
  
  market_scenario_id = "baseline",
   
  demand_scenario_id = "baseline",
   expected_policy_year = 2025L,
  expected_profiles = 10000L, expected_conversion_train_rows = 6000L, expected_conversion_validation_rows = 2000L,
  expected_conversion_test_rows = 2000L, 
  multiplier_lower = 0.95,
   
  multiplier_upper = 1.05,
   multiplier_step = 0.01,
  
  maximum_admissible_claim_ratio = 0.800,
   minimum_portfolio_margin_retention = 1.00,
  
  minimum_unit_margin_retention = 0.90,
   
  targeted_rate_level_lower = 0.995,
   targeted_rate_level_upper = 1.005,
  # Minimum validation profiles required in a targeting segment. Rare levels
  # of categorical variables are collapsed into "Other" where appropriate.
  minimum_targeted_segment_profiles = 50L,
  # Continuous targeting variables are grouped using validation-derived
  # quartiles. These cut-points are frozen before the test set is opened.
  targeted_numeric_quantiles = 4L,
  # If several segmentation bases are within this absolute validation
  # conversion-rate tolerance of the best result, prefer the more parsimonious
  # segmentation (fewer pricing segments).
  targeted_segmentation_selection_tolerance = 0.0005,
  # Uniform strategies maximise model-expected underwriting margin subject to
  # retaining at least this share of technical-benchmark expected conversion.
  minimum_uniform_conversion_retention = 0.95,
  # Targeted strategy explicitly seeks conversion improvement while preserving
  # margin and rate level.
  minimum_targeted_conversion_retention = 1.00,
  # Development-only probability recalibration.
  probability_clip = 1e-6, write_plots = TRUE,
  # Optional audit-only Module 1 truth. This variable is NEVER used to select
  # prices; it is opened only after strategy evaluation.
  module1_truth_file = file.path( "outputs", "synthetic_generator_multiyear", "synthetic_motor_full_truth.rds" ) )
set.seed(
  config$seed )
dir.create(
  config$output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE )
multiplier_grid <- seq( from = config$multiplier_lower, to = config$multiplier_upper, by = config$multiplier_step )
multiplier_grid <- round( multiplier_grid, 10 )
if ( !1 %in% multiplier_grid
) {
  stop( "The candidate multiplier grid must contain 1.00." )
}
```

```{r module-6-pricing-optimisation, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 1. UTILITY FUNCTIONS
safe_divide <- function( numerator, denominator
) {
  result <- numerator / denominator
  result[ !is.finite( result ) ] <- NA_real_
  result
}
clip_probability <- function( probability, epsilon = config$probability_clip
) {
  pmin( pmax( as.numeric( probability ), epsilon ), 1 - epsilon )
}
assert_file <- function( path, description
) {
  if ( !file.exists( path )
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Missing ", description, ": ", path ) )
  }
}
safe_read_rds <- function( path, description = basename( path ), attempts = 3L
) {
  assert_file( path, description )
  last_error <- NULL
  for ( attempt in seq_len( attempts )
  ) {
    result <- tryCatch(
        {
          base::readRDS( path )
        },
        error = function(e) {
          last_error <<- e
          NULL
        } )
    if ( !is.null( result )
    ) {
      return( result )
    }
    # Repeated sensitivity runs can leave large model objects awaiting garbage
    # collection. Clear unreachable objects before retrying an RDS connection.
    invisible( gc( verbose = FALSE ) )
    Sys.sleep( 0.25 * attempt )
  }
  stop( paste0( "Could not read ", description, " after ", attempts, " attempt(s): ", conditionMessage( last_error
      ), ". File: ", path ) )
}
assert_columns <- function( data, required_columns, data_name
) {
  missing_columns <- setdiff( required_columns, names( data ) )
  if ( length( missing_columns ) > 0L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( data_name, " is missing required columns: ", paste( missing_columns, collapse = ", " ) ) )
  }
}
read_and_assert_validation <- function( path, description, required_only = FALSE
) {
  assert_file( path, description )
  checks <- readr::read_csv( path, show_col_types = FALSE )
  assert_columns( checks, "pass", description )
  checks_to_enforce <- checks
  if ( isTRUE( required_only ) && "required_for_progress" %in% names( checks )
  ) {
    checks_to_enforce <- checks %>% filter( required_for_progress )
  }
  failed <- checks_to_enforce %>% filter( is.na( pass ) | !pass )
  if ( nrow( failed ) > 0L
  ) {
    failed_names <- if ( "check_name" %in% names( failed )
      ) {
        paste( failed$check_name, collapse = "; " )
      } else {
        paste0( nrow( failed ), " failed check(s)" )
      }
    stop( paste0( description, " contains failed required validation checks: ", failed_names ) )
  }
  checks
}
log_sum_exp <- function( x
) {
  maximum_x <- max( x )
  maximum_x + log( sum( exp( x - maximum_x ) ) )
}
fit_probability_calibration <- function( outcome, raw_probability, model_name
) {
  raw_probability <- clip_probability( raw_probability )
  calibration_data <- tibble( outcome = as.integer( outcome ), raw_logit = qlogis( raw_probability ) )
  fit <- tryCatch( suppressWarnings( glm( outcome ~ raw_logit, data = calibration_data, family = binomial(
              link = "logit" ) ) ),
      error = function(e) {
        NULL
      } )
  if ( is.null( fit ) || length( coef( fit ) ) < 2L || any( !is.finite( coef( fit ) ) )
  ) {
    warning( paste0( "Validation recalibration failed for ", model_name, "; identity calibration will be used." ) )
    return( tibble( calibration_intercept = 0, calibration_slope = 1 ) )
  }
  tibble( calibration_intercept = unname( coef( fit )[ 1 ] ), calibration_slope = unname( coef( fit )[ 2 ] ) )
}
apply_probability_calibration <- function( raw_probability, calibration_intercept, calibration_slope
) {
  raw_probability <- clip_probability( raw_probability )
  clip_probability( plogis( calibration_intercept + calibration_slope * qlogis( raw_probability ) ) )
}
model_family_from_object <- function( model, metadata_type = NULL
) {
  if ( !is.null( metadata_type ) && length( metadata_type ) == 1L && !is.na( metadata_type ) && metadata_type %in%
        c( "glm", "gam" )
  ) {
    return( metadata_type )
  }
  if ( inherits( model, "gam" )
  ) {
    return( "gam" )
  }
  if ( inherits( model, "glm" )
  ) {
    return( "glm" )
  }
  stop( paste0( "Unsupported conversion-model class under the final GLM/GAM framework: ", paste( class( model ),
        collapse = ", " ) ) )
}
predict_probability <- function( model, new_data, model_name, model_type = NULL
) {
  resolved_model_type <- model_family_from_object( model = model, metadata_type = model_type )
  prediction <- tryCatch(
      {
        as.numeric( stats::predict( model, newdata = new_data, type = "response" ) )
      },
      error = function(e) {
        stop( paste0( "Prediction failed for ", model_name, " [", resolved_model_type, "]: ", conditionMessage( e )
          ) )
      } )
  if ( length( prediction ) != nrow( new_data ) || any( !is.finite( prediction ) )
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Invalid prediction vector generated by ", model_name, "." ) )
  }
  clip_probability( prediction )
}
extract_single_calibration <- function( calibration_table, model_name
) {
  row <- calibration_table %>% filter( model == model_name )
  if ( nrow( row ) != 1L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Expected exactly one calibration row for ", model_name, "." ) )
  }
  list( intercept = row$calibration_intercept[ 1 ], slope = row$calibration_slope[ 1 ] )
}
```

```{r module-6-pricing-optimisation, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 3. READ MODULE 5 AND MODULE 3 OBSERVABLE INPUTS
# Frozen upstream validation is enforced before optimisation starts. Module 5
# contains one explicitly optional model-complexity check, so only checks marked
# required_for_progress are enforced there. Modules 3 and 4 require all checks
# to pass. Reading these validation summaries does not expose Module 4 truth.
module5_validation_checks <- read_and_assert_validation( module5_validation_path,
  "Module 5 model_validation_checks.csv", required_only = TRUE )
module3_validation_checks <- read_and_assert_validation( module3_validation_path,
  "Module 3 quote_market_validation_checks.csv" )
module4_validation_checks <- read_and_assert_validation( module4_validation_path,
  "Module 4 conversion_generation_validation_checks.csv" )
development_models <- safe_read_rds( development_models_path )
final_models <- safe_read_rds( final_models_path )
final_selected_model <- safe_read_rds( selected_model_path )
final_own_price_model <- safe_read_rds( own_price_model_path )
prepared_data <- safe_read_rds( prepared_data_path )
development_predictions <- safe_read_rds( development_predictions_path )
selected_model_metadata <- safe_read_rds( selected_metadata_path )

required_module5_metadata_fields <- c( "module_version", "model_family_scope", "candidate_models",

  "quote_market_profiles", "technical_data_split", "conversion_split_counts", "development_test_overlap",
  "development_test_predictions_generated" )

if ( length( missing_module5_metadata_fields ) > 0L
) {
  stop( paste0( "selected_model_metadata.rds is missing revised Module 5 field(s): ", paste(
        missing_module5_metadata_fields, collapse = ", " ) ) )
}
expected_module5_version <- "M5-GLMGAM-OOT-2026-09-18"
expected_module5_families <- c( "glm", "gam" )
expected_module5_candidates <- c( "Technical-only GLM", "Own-price GLM", "Relative-price GLM", "Rank GLM",
    "Market-position GLM", "Market-position GAM" )
if ( !identical( as.character( selected_model_metadata$module_version ), expected_module5_version )
) {
  stop( paste0( "Module 6 requires final Module 5 version ", expected_module5_version, "; observed ", as.character(
        selected_model_metadata$module_version ), "." ) )
}
if ( !setequal( as.character( selected_model_metadata$model_family_scope ), expected_module5_families ) || length(
      selected_model_metadata$model_family_scope ) != length( expected_module5_families )
) {
  stop( "Module 6 requires the final Module 5 GLM/GAM-only model-family scope." )
}
if ( !identical( as.character( selected_model_metadata$candidate_models ), expected_module5_candidates )
) {
  stop( "Module 5 candidate-model register does not match the final six-model GLM/GAM framework." )
}
if ( !as.character( selected_model_metadata$selected_model_name ) %in% c( "Market-position GLM",
      "Market-position GAM" )
) {
  stop( "The final Module 5 selected model must be Market-position GLM or Market-position GAM." )
}
if ( !as.character( selected_model_metadata$selected_model_type ) %in% c( "glm", "gam" )
) {
  stop( "The final Module 5 selected model type must be 'glm' or 'gam'." )
}
module5_split_counts <- selected_model_metadata$conversion_split_counts
if ( as.integer( selected_model_metadata$quote_market_policy_year ) != config$expected_policy_year || as.integer(
      selected_model_metadata$quote_market_profiles ) != config$expected_profiles || !identical( as.character(
        selected_model_metadata$technical_data_split ), "test" ) || as.integer( module5_split_counts[["train"]]
    ) != config$expected_conversion_train_rows || as.integer( module5_split_counts[["validation"]] ) !=
      config$expected_conversion_validation_rows || as.integer( module5_split_counts[["test"]] ) !=
      config$expected_conversion_test_rows || as.integer( selected_model_metadata$development_test_overlap ) !=
      0L || isTRUE( selected_model_metadata$development_test_predictions_generated )
) {
  stop( "Module 5 metadata does not match the frozen 2025 / 6000-2000-2000 no-TEST-development architecture." )
}
assert_columns( development_predictions, c( "policy_id", "quote_profile_id", "policy_year", "technical_data_split",
    "conversion_data_split", "data_split", "focal_conversion", "model", "predicted_probability" ),

if ( any( as.character( development_predictions$conversion_data_split ) == "test" ) || any( as.character(

) {
```

```{r module-6-pricing-optimisation, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 4. VALIDATE PREPARED DATA AND SCENARIO
required_prepared_columns <- c( "scenario_id", "demand_scenario_id", "policy_id", "quote_profile_id",
  "policy_year", "technical_data_split", "conversion_data_split", "data_split", "state", "remoteness_area",
  "driver_age", "age_band", "licence_years", "vehicle_age", "vehicle_segment", "motive_power", "engine_capacity_l",
  "cylinder_count", "power_kw", "torque_nm", "unladen_weight_kg", "transmission", "vehicle_value", "annual_km",
  "voluntary_excess", "prior_claims_5yr", "claim_free_years", "technical_premium", "estimated_expected_claim_cost",
  "focal_quote", "n_competitor_quotes", "within_profile_competitor_spread_ratio", "log_competitor_spread",
  "focal_conversion" )
assert_columns( prepared_data, required_prepared_columns, "prepared_conversion_data.rds" )
explicit_forbidden_prepared_columns <- c( "claim_count", "pricing_claim_count", "incurred_claim_cost",
  "reconstructed_incurred_claim_cost", "gross_claim_cost", "average_paid_claim_cost",
  "pricing_average_paid_claim_cost", "largest_paid_claim", "total_loss_claim_count", "any_total_loss",
  "reconstructed_reported_claim_count", "incurred_claim_cost_nominal", "gross_claim_cost_nominal",
  "average_paid_claim_cost_nominal", "largest_paid_claim_nominal", "driver_sex_audit" )
pattern_forbidden_prepared_columns <- names( prepared_data )[ stringr::str_detect( names( prepared_data ),
    stringr::regex( paste( c( "^true_", "^latent_", "price_sensitivity_z", "taste_shock", "utility",
          "purchase_uniform", "choice_uniform", "participation_intercept", "calibrated_focal_brand_utility",
          "focal_selected_if_purchase", "^market_purchase$" ), collapse = "|" ), ignore_case = TRUE ) ) ]
forbidden_prepared_columns <- union( intersect( explicit_forbidden_prepared_columns, names( prepared_data ) ),
  pattern_forbidden_prepared_columns )
if ( length( forbidden_prepared_columns ) > 0L
) {
  stop( paste0( "Module 6 prepared-data leakage check failed: ", paste( forbidden_prepared_columns, collapse = ", "
      ) ) )
}
assert_columns( competitor_quotes, c( "policy_id", "quote_profile_id", "competitor_id", "competitor_archetype",
    "competitor_quote" ), "competitor_quotes.csv" )
pricing_data <- prepared_data %>% filter( scenario_id == config$market_scenario_id, demand_scenario_id ==
      config$demand_scenario_id ) %>% mutate( policy_year = as.integer( policy_year ), technical_data_split =
      tolower( trimws( as.character( technical_data_split ) ) ), conversion_data_split = tolower( trimws(
          as.character( conversion_data_split ) ) ), data_split = tolower( trimws( as.character( data_split ) ) ) )
if ( nrow( pricing_data ) != config$expected_profiles
) {
  stop( paste0( "Module 6 requires exactly ", config$expected_profiles,
      " rows for the selected 2025 scenario; observed ", nrow( pricing_data ), "." ) )
}
if ( anyDuplicated( pricing_data$policy_id ) > 0L || anyDuplicated( pricing_data$quote_profile_id ) > 0L
) {
  stop( "Pricing data must contain unique policy_id and quote_profile_id values." )
}
if ( !all( pricing_data$policy_year == config$expected_policy_year )
) {
  stop( "Module 6 must receive the 2025 quote cohort only." )
}
if ( !all( pricing_data$technical_data_split == "test" )
) {
  stop( "technical_data_split must remain 'test' for every Module 6 row." )
}
if ( !all( pricing_data$data_split == pricing_data$conversion_data_split )
) {
  stop( "data_split must remain an exact alias of conversion_data_split." )
}
pricing_split_summary <- pricing_data %>% count( conversion_data_split, name = "profiles" ) %>% mutate( share =
      profiles / sum( profiles ) )
pricing_split_count <- function( split_name
) {
  value <- pricing_split_summary %>% filter( conversion_data_split == split_name ) %>% pull( profiles )
  if ( length( value ) != 1L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Unable to recover exactly one Module 6 row count for split ", split_name, "." ) )
  }
  as.integer( value )
}
if ( pricing_split_count( "train" ) != config$expected_conversion_train_rows || pricing_split_count( "validation"
    ) != config$expected_conversion_validation_rows || pricing_split_count( "test" ) !=
      config$expected_conversion_test_rows
) {
  stop( paste0( "Module 6 split does not match the frozen 6000/2000/2000 design. ",
      "Observed train/validation/test = ", pricing_split_count( "train" ), "/", pricing_split_count( "validation"
      ), "/", pricing_split_count( "test" ), "." ) )
}
pricing_sample_architecture <- tibble( policy_year = config$expected_policy_year, total_profiles = nrow(
      pricing_data ), technical_data_split = "test", conversion_train_profiles = pricing_split_count( "train" ),
  conversion_validation_profiles = pricing_split_count( "validation" ), conversion_test_profiles =
    pricing_split_count( "test" ), pricing_rule_selection_sample = "conversion VALIDATION only",
  pricing_rule_evaluation_sample = "conversion TEST only", test_outcome_used_for_strategy_selection = FALSE,
  latent_truth_used_for_strategy_selection = FALSE )
pricing_vehicle_specification_audit <- tibble( market_scenario_id = config$market_scenario_id, demand_scenario_id =
    config$demand_scenario_id, policy_year = config$expected_policy_year, profiles = nrow( pricing_data ),
  conversion_validation_profiles = pricing_split_count( "validation" ), conversion_test_profiles =
    pricing_split_count( "test" ), valid_engine_capacity_share = mean( is.finite( pricing_data$engine_capacity_l
      ) & pricing_data$engine_capacity_l >= 0 ), valid_cylinder_count_share = mean( is.finite(
        pricing_data$cylinder_count ) & pricing_data$cylinder_count >= 0 ), positive_power_share = mean( is.finite(
        pricing_data$power_kw ) & pricing_data$power_kw > 0 ), positive_torque_share = mean( is.finite(
        pricing_data$torque_nm ) & pricing_data$torque_nm > 0 ), positive_unladen_weight_share = mean( is.finite(
        pricing_data$unladen_weight_kg ) & pricing_data$unladen_weight_kg > 0 ), nonblank_transmission_share =
    mean( !is.na( pricing_data$transmission ) & nzchar( trimws( as.character( pricing_data$transmission ) ) ) ),
  used_as_direct_pricing_constraint_variable = FALSE, tested_as_targeting_segmentation = TRUE, rationale = paste(
      "Vehicle specifications are retained from the frozen upstream pipeline",
      "and tested as alternative one-variable targeting bases. No directional",
      "effect is hard-coded: they can influence the selected commercial action",
      "only through validation-sample pricing response and upstream technical", "pricing economics." ) )
if ( any( pricing_vehicle_specification_audit %>% dplyr::select( valid_engine_capacity_share,
        valid_cylinder_count_share, positive_power_share, positive_torque_share, positive_unladen_weight_share,
        nonblank_transmission_share ) %>% unlist( use.names = FALSE ) < 1 )
) {
  stop( "Frozen vehicle-specification fields are incomplete in prepared_conversion_data.rds." )
}

# The TEST working table is deliberately outcome-blind. focal_conversion is not
# required for counterfactual pricing evaluation and is therefore removed here.
test_data <- pricing_data %>% filter( conversion_data_split == "test" ) %>% dplyr::select( -focal_conversion )
if ( nrow( validation_data ) != config$expected_conversion_validation_rows || nrow( test_data ) !=
      config$expected_conversion_test_rows
) {

if ( "focal_conversion" %in% names( test_data )
) {
```

```{r module-6-pricing-optimisation, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 6. CANDIDATE-PRICE FEATURE ENGINEERING
construct_candidate_data <- function( base_data, multiplier
) {
  if ( length( multiplier ) == 1L
  ) {
    multiplier_vector <- rep( multiplier, nrow( base_data ) )
  } else if ( length( multiplier ) == nrow( base_data )
  ) {
    multiplier_vector <- as.numeric( multiplier )
  } else {
    stop( "Candidate multiplier must be scalar or have one value per base-data row." )
  }
  candidate <- base_data %>% mutate( strategy_multiplier = multiplier_vector, candidate_price = technical_premium *
          strategy_multiplier ) %>% left_join( competitor_lists, by = c( "policy_id", "quote_profile_id" ) )
  if ( anyNA( candidate$competitor_quote_vector )
  ) {
    stop( "At least one candidate profile is missing its competitor quote vector." )
  }
  candidate <- candidate %>% mutate( cheapest_competitor_quote = purrr::map_dbl( competitor_quote_vector, min ),
      mean_competitor_quote = purrr::map_dbl( competitor_quote_vector, mean ), median_competitor_quote =
        purrr::map_dbl( competitor_quote_vector, median ), sd_competitor_quote = purrr::map_dbl(
          competitor_quote_vector, sd ), focal_rank = purrr::map2_int( competitor_quote_vector, candidate_price,
          ~ 1L + sum( .x < .y ) ), market_median_quote = purrr::map2_dbl( competitor_quote_vector, candidate_price,
          ~ median( c( .x, .y ) ) ), focal_quote = candidate_price, focal_price = candidate_price,
      focal_price_multiplier = strategy_multiplier, relative_price = safe_divide( candidate_price,
          cheapest_competitor_quote ), relative_price_to_cheapest_competitor = relative_price,
      price_gap_to_cheapest = candidate_price - cheapest_competitor_quote, gap_to_cheapest = price_gap_to_cheapest,
      percentage_gap_to_cheapest_competitor = relative_price_to_cheapest_competitor - 1,
      relative_price_to_market_median = safe_divide( candidate_price, market_median_quote ),
      relative_to_market_median = relative_price_to_market_median, distance_to_market_median = candidate_price -
          market_median_quote, focal_rank_percentile = safe_divide( focal_rank - 1, n_competitor_quotes ),
      log_focal_to_technical = log( candidate_price / technical_premium ), log_relative_price_to_cheapest = log(
          relative_price_to_cheapest_competitor ), gap_above_market_threshold = pmax(
          percentage_gap_to_cheapest_competitor - selected_model_metadata$market_gap_threshold, 0 ),
      log_relative_price_to_market_median = log( relative_price_to_market_median ),
      # Competitor dispersion and comparison-set size do not change when only
      # the focal insurer reprices.
      log_competitor_spread = log( within_profile_competitor_spread_ratio ) )
  numeric_check_columns <- c( "candidate_price", "cheapest_competitor_quote", "market_median_quote",
    "relative_price_to_cheapest_competitor", "relative_price_to_market_median", "focal_rank_percentile",
    "log_focal_to_technical", "log_relative_price_to_cheapest", "log_relative_price_to_market_median" )
  if ( any( !is.finite( as.matrix( candidate[ numeric_check_columns ] ) ) )
  ) {
    stop( "Candidate-price feature engineering produced non-finite values." )
  }
  candidate %>% dplyr::select( -competitor_quote_vector, -competitor_count_from_file )
}
```

```{r module-6-pricing-optimisation, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 8. CANDIDATE PREDICTION FUNCTION
add_candidate_predictions <- function( candidate_data, model_stage = c( "development", "final" )
) {
  model_stage <- match.arg( model_stage )
  if ( model_stage == "development"
  ) {
    own_model <- development_own_price_model
    market_model <- development_selected_model
  } else {
    own_model <- final_own_price_model
    market_model <- final_selected_model
  }
  own_raw <- predict_probability( model = own_model, new_data = candidate_data, model_name = paste( model_stage,
          "Own-price GLM" ), model_type = "glm" )
  market_raw <- predict_probability( model = market_model, new_data = candidate_data, model_name = paste(
          model_stage, selected_model_name ), model_type = selected_model_type )
  candidate_data %>% mutate( own_price_model_probability_raw = own_raw, own_price_model_probability =
        apply_probability_calibration( raw_probability = own_raw, calibration_intercept =
            own_calibration$intercept, calibration_slope = own_calibration$slope ), market_model_probability_raw =
        market_raw, market_model_probability = apply_probability_calibration( raw_probability = market_raw,
          calibration_intercept = market_calibration$intercept, calibration_slope = market_calibration$slope ),
      own_price_expected_margin = own_price_model_probability * ( candidate_price - estimated_expected_claim_cost
          ), market_model_expected_margin = market_model_probability * ( candidate_price -
              estimated_expected_claim_cost ), own_price_expected_written_premium = own_price_model_probability *
          candidate_price, market_model_expected_written_premium = market_model_probability * candidate_price,
      own_price_expected_claim_cost = own_price_model_probability * estimated_expected_claim_cost,
      market_model_expected_claim_cost = market_model_probability * estimated_expected_claim_cost )
}
# 8.1 MODULE 5 ORIGINAL-QUOTE PREDICTION RECONSTRUCTION
# Module 5 was fitted and evaluated at the ORIGINAL focal quotes generated by
# Module 3. Those quotes are not generally equal to the actuarial technical
# premium:
#   original_focal_multiplier_i =
#       focal_quote_i / technical_premium_i
# Therefore a valid interface audit must reconstruct every validation profile
# at its own original focal multiplier.
# This is deliberately different from the Module 6 "technical-pricing
# benchmark", which sets the candidate multiplier to exactly 1.00.
# At the original focal multipliers, all reconstructed price-position variables
# should match Module 5 and the raw predicted probabilities should therefore
# agree to numerical precision. This provides a high-value GLM/GAM
# interface check before any optimisation is performed.
validation_original_quote_multiplier <- validation_data$focal_quote / validation_data$technical_premium
if ( any( !is.finite( validation_original_quote_multiplier ) ) || any( validation_original_quote_multiplier <= 0 )
) {
  stop( "Invalid original focal-quote multiplier in Module 5 reconstruction audit." )
}
validation_original_quote_reconstruction <- construct_candidate_data( base_data = validation_data, multiplier =
      validation_original_quote_multiplier )
# Verify that the reconstructed candidate price itself returns to the Module 3
# focal quote before comparing model predictions.
original_quote_price_reconstruction_audit <- validation_original_quote_reconstruction %>% transmute(
    quote_profile_id, stored_focal_quote = validation_data$focal_quote, reconstructed_focal_quote = focal_quote,
    absolute_price_difference = abs( reconstructed_focal_quote - stored_focal_quote ) )
validation_original_own_raw <- predict_probability( model = development_own_price_model, new_data =
      validation_original_quote_reconstruction, model_name =
      "development Own-price GLM original-quote reconstruction", model_type = "glm" )
validation_original_market_raw <- predict_probability( model = development_selected_model, new_data =
      validation_original_quote_reconstruction, model_name = paste( "development", selected_model_name,
        "original-quote reconstruction" ), model_type = selected_model_type )
stored_validation_original_predictions <- development_predictions %>% filter( data_split == "validation",
    model %in% c( "Own-price GLM", selected_model_name ) ) %>% dplyr::select( quote_profile_id, model,
    predicted_probability )
own_stored_validation <- stored_validation_original_predictions %>% filter( model == "Own-price GLM" ) %>%
  dplyr::select( quote_profile_id, stored_probability = predicted_probability )
market_stored_validation <- stored_validation_original_predictions %>% filter( model == selected_model_name ) %>%
  dplyr::select( quote_profile_id, stored_probability = predicted_probability )
own_reconstruction_audit <- validation_original_quote_reconstruction %>% transmute( quote_profile_id,
    reconstructed_probability = validation_original_own_raw ) %>% left_join( own_stored_validation, by =
      "quote_profile_id" )
market_reconstruction_audit <- validation_original_quote_reconstruction %>% transmute( quote_profile_id,
    reconstructed_probability = validation_original_market_raw ) %>% left_join( market_stored_validation, by =
      "quote_profile_id" )
if ( anyNA( own_reconstruction_audit$stored_probability ) || anyNA( market_reconstruction_audit$stored_probability
    )
) {
  stop( "Module 5 original-quote prediction reconciliation is missing validation profiles." )
}
prediction_interface_reconstruction <- tibble( model = c( "Original focal quote", "Own-price GLM",
      selected_model_name ), model_type = c( "price reconstruction", "glm", selected_model_type ), profiles = c(
      nrow( original_quote_price_reconstruction_audit ), nrow( own_reconstruction_audit ), nrow(
        market_reconstruction_audit ) ), max_absolute_difference = c( max(
        original_quote_price_reconstruction_audit$absolute_price_difference ), max( abs(
          own_reconstruction_audit$reconstructed_probability - own_reconstruction_audit$stored_probability ) ),
      max( abs( market_reconstruction_audit$reconstructed_probability -
            market_reconstruction_audit$stored_probability ) ) ), difference_scale = c( "currency", "probability",
      "probability" ) )
```

```{r module-6-pricing-optimisation, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 13. TARGETING-SEGMENTATION REGISTER AND VALIDATION-ONLY DEFINITIONS
# The segmentation exercise is deliberately one-variable-at-a-time. This keeps
# the commercial interpretation transparent and avoids a sparse high-dimensional
# pricing-cell design. Continuous characteristics use validation-derived bands;
# categorical characteristics generally use observed levels. Where a naturally
# ordered domain structure exists, sparse levels are pooled with adjacent,
# interpretable categories rather than placed in a generic "Other" cell.
segmentation_descriptors <- tribble( ~segmentation_id, ~segmentation_name, ~segmentation_category,
  ~source_variable, ~rule_type, ~rationale, "age_band", "Driver age band", "Driver / experience", "age_band",
  "categorical",
  "Pre-specified benchmark segmentation. Age can proxy for both risk and heterogeneous shopping behaviour.",
  "licence_years_band", "Licence-years band", "Driver / experience", "licence_years", "quantile",
  "Tests whether driving experience identifies different commercial price responses.", "prior_claims_band",
  "Prior-claims band", "Driver / experience", "prior_claims_5yr", "prior_claims",
  "Claims history affects technical risk and may also change the competitiveness of the offered premium.",
  "claim_free_years_band", "Claim-free-years band", "Driver / experience", "claim_free_years", "claim_free",
  "Tests whether sustained claim-free experience identifies distinct pricing opportunity.", "state", "State",
  "Geography", "state", "categorical",
  "Tests broad geographic differences in risk mix, competitor position and customer response.", "remoteness_area",
  "Remoteness area", "Geography", "remoteness_area", "remoteness",
  "Tests whether metropolitan and regional/remote quote opportunities respond differently to repricing.",
  "vehicle_segment", "Vehicle segment", "Vehicle class / technology", "vehicle_segment", "categorical",
  "Vehicle classes can differ in repair economics, driver mix and customer price sensitivity.", "motive_power",
  "Motive power", "Vehicle class / technology", "motive_power", "categorical",
  "Tests whether petrol, diesel, hybrid and electric vehicle markets exhibit different commercial pricing response.",
  "transmission", "Transmission", "Vehicle class / technology", "transmission", "categorical",
  "A diagnostic vehicle-characteristic segmentation that may proxy for vehicle type and driver mix.",
  "vehicle_age_band", "Vehicle-age band", "Vehicle specification", "vehicle_age", "vehicle_age",
  "Tests whether newer and older vehicles offer different risk-margin and conversion trade-offs.",
  "vehicle_value_band", "Vehicle-value band", "Vehicle specification", "vehicle_value", "quantile",
  "Vehicle value is directly relevant to loss economics and may also proxy for premium affordability and shopping behaviour.",
  "engine_capacity_band", "Engine-capacity band", "Vehicle specification", "engine_capacity_l", "quantile",
  "Tests engine displacement as a vehicle-performance/risk marker without imposing a directional effect.",
  "cylinder_count", "Cylinder count", "Vehicle specification", "cylinder_count", "cylinder_group",
  "Tests a traditional engine configuration characteristic as a commercial segmentation basis.", "power_band",
  "Power band", "Vehicle specification", "power_kw", "quantile",
  "Higher power may be associated with vehicle performance, driver selection and collision dynamics, but no causal direction is imposed.",
  "torque_band", "Torque band", "Vehicle specification", "torque_nm", "quantile",
  "Tests whether torque-defined vehicle groups have distinct commercial response after technical pricing has already been estimated.",
  "unladen_weight_band", "Unladen-weight band", "Vehicle specification", "unladen_weight_kg", "quantile",
  "Vehicle mass may proxy for vehicle class, repair economics and collision characteristics.", "annual_km_band",
  "Annual-kilometres band", "Usage / policy choice", "annual_km", "quantile",
  "Mileage is a direct exposure proxy and may identify customers with different premium and conversion trade-offs.",
  "voluntary_excess", "Voluntary excess", "Usage / policy choice", "voluntary_excess", "categorical",
  "Tests whether policyholders choosing different excess levels display different pricing opportunity.",
  "distribution_channel", "Distribution channel", "Commercial / channel", "distribution_channel", "categorical",
  "Would test shopping-intensity differences by channel if the field were available in the frozen upstream dataset."
)
normalise_segment_character <- function( x
) {
  value <- trimws( as.character( x ) )
  value[ is.na( value ) | value == "" ] <- NA_character_
  value
}
build_segmentation_spec <- function( descriptor_row, validation_frame
) {
  segmentation_id <- descriptor_row$segmentation_id[ 1 ]
  segmentation_name <- descriptor_row$segmentation_name[ 1 ]
  segmentation_category <- descriptor_row$segmentation_category[ 1 ]
  source_variable <- descriptor_row$source_variable[ 1 ]
  rule_type <- descriptor_row$rule_type[ 1 ]
  rationale <- descriptor_row$rationale[ 1 ]
  if ( !source_variable %in% names( validation_frame )
  ) {
    return( list( eligible = FALSE, segmentation_id = segmentation_id, segmentation_name = segmentation_name,
        segmentation_category = segmentation_category, source_variable = source_variable, rule_type = rule_type,
        rationale = rationale, definition = "Not available in frozen Modules 0-5 interface.", reason =
          "Source variable absent from prepared_conversion_data.rds.", transform = NULL ) )
  }
  validation_value <- validation_frame[[ source_variable ]]
  transform_function <- NULL
  definition <- NA_character_
  reason <- NA_character_
  if ( identical( rule_type, "remoteness" )
  ) {
    transform_function <- function( x
    ) {
      clean <- normalise_segment_character( x )
      dplyr::case_when( clean %in% c( "Major Cities", "Major Cities of Australia" ) ~ "Major Cities", clean %in% c(
            "Inner Regional", "Inner Regional Australia" ) ~ "Inner Regional", clean %in% c( "Outer Regional",
            "Outer Regional Australia" ) ~ "Outer Regional", clean %in% c( "Remote", "Remote Australia",
            "Very Remote", "Very Remote Australia" ) ~ "Remote / Very Remote", TRUE ~ NA_character_ )
    }
    definition <- paste0( "Major Cities, Inner Regional, Outer Regional and Remote / Very Remote. ",
        "Remote and Very Remote are pooled because Very Remote alone has fewer than ",
        config$minimum_targeted_segment_profiles,
        " validation profiles; the pooling follows the ordinal remoteness hierarchy rather than a generic Other category."
      )
  } else if ( identical( rule_type, "cylinder_group" )
  ) {
    transform_function <- function( x
    ) {
      numeric_x <- as.numeric( x )
      dplyr::case_when( !is.finite( numeric_x ) ~ NA_character_, numeric_x == 0 ~
          "0 cylinders (EV / not applicable)", numeric_x <= 3 ~ "1-3 cylinders", numeric_x == 4 ~ "4 cylinders",
        numeric_x <= 6 ~ "5-6 cylinders", TRUE ~ "7+ cylinders" )
    }
    definition <- paste0( "Ordered cylinder groups: 0 (EV / not applicable), 1-3, 4, 5-6 and 7+ cylinders. ",
        "The rare 5-cylinder configuration is pooled with adjacent 6-cylinder vehicles to satisfy the ",
        config$minimum_targeted_segment_profiles,
        "-profile validation-cell rule without creating an uninformative generic Other category." )
  } else if ( identical( rule_type, "categorical" )
  ) {
    clean_validation <- normalise_segment_character( validation_value )
    if ( anyNA( clean_validation )
    ) {
      reason <- "Missing or blank values detected in the validation sample."
    } else {
      level_counts <- table( clean_validation )
      rare_levels <- names( level_counts[ level_counts < config$minimum_targeted_segment_profiles ] )
      kept_levels <- setdiff( names( level_counts ), rare_levels )
      has_other <- length( rare_levels ) > 0L
      transform_function <- local({
        kept_levels_local <- kept_levels
        rare_levels_local <- rare_levels
        has_other_local <- has_other
        function( x
        ) {
          clean <- normalise_segment_character( x )
          output <- rep( NA_character_, length( clean ) )
          output[ !is.na( clean ) & clean %in% kept_levels_local ] <- clean[ !is.na( clean ) & clean %in%
                  kept_levels_local ]
          if ( has_other_local
          ) {
            output[ !is.na( clean ) & clean %in% rare_levels_local ] <- "Other"
          }
          output
        }
      })
      definition <- if ( has_other
        ) {
          paste0( "Observed validation categories; levels with fewer than ",
            config$minimum_targeted_segment_profiles, " validation profiles collapsed to Other: ", paste(
              rare_levels, collapse = ", " ), "." )
        } else {
          "Observed validation categories used directly."
        }
    }
  } else if ( identical( rule_type, "quantile" )
  ) {
    numeric_validation <- as.numeric( validation_value )
    if ( any( !is.finite( numeric_validation ) )
    ) {
      reason <- "Non-finite values detected in the validation sample."
    } else {
      requested_quantiles <- as.integer( config$targeted_numeric_quantiles )
      raw_quantiles <- as.numeric( stats::quantile( numeric_validation, probs = seq( 0, 1, length.out =
                  requested_quantiles + 1L ), names = FALSE, type = 8 ) )
      internal_breaks <- unique( raw_quantiles[ 2:requested_quantiles ] )
      cut_breaks <- c( -Inf, internal_breaks, Inf )
      n_intervals <- length( cut_breaks ) - 1L
      if ( n_intervals < 2L
      ) {
        reason <- "Too little numeric variation to construct at least two targeting bands."
      } else {
        interval_labels <- paste0( "Q", seq_len( n_intervals ) )
        if ( n_intervals >= 2L
        ) {
          interval_labels[ 1 ] <- paste0( interval_labels[ 1 ], " (lowest)" )
          interval_labels[ n_intervals ] <- paste0( interval_labels[ n_intervals ], " (highest)" )
        }
        transform_function <- local({
          breaks_local <- cut_breaks
          labels_local <- interval_labels
          function( x
          ) {
            numeric_x <- as.numeric( x )
            output <- as.character( cut( numeric_x, breaks = breaks_local, labels = labels_local, include.lowest =
                    TRUE, right = TRUE ) )
            output[ !is.finite( numeric_x ) ] <- NA_character_
            output
          }
        })
        definition <- paste0( "Validation-derived quantile bands using internal cut-points: ", paste( signif(
                internal_breaks, 6 ), collapse = ", " ), "." )
      }
    }
  } else if ( identical( rule_type, "prior_claims" )
  ) {
    transform_function <- function( x
    ) {
      numeric_x <- as.numeric( x )
      dplyr::case_when( !is.finite( numeric_x ) ~ NA_character_, numeric_x <= 0 ~ "0 claims", numeric_x == 1 ~
          "1 claim", numeric_x == 2 ~ "2 claims", TRUE ~ "3+ claims" )
    }
    definition <- "0, 1, 2 and 3+ prior claims over the five-year history."
  } else if ( identical( rule_type, "claim_free" )
  ) {
    transform_function <- function( x
    ) {
      numeric_x <- as.numeric( x )
      dplyr::case_when( !is.finite( numeric_x ) ~ NA_character_, numeric_x <= 0 ~ "0 years", numeric_x <= 2 ~
          "1-2 years", numeric_x <= 4 ~ "3-4 years", TRUE ~ "5+ years" )
    }
    definition <- "0, 1-2, 3-4 and 5+ consecutive claim-free years."
  } else if ( identical( rule_type, "vehicle_age" )
  ) {
    transform_function <- function( x
    ) {
      numeric_x <- as.numeric( x )
      dplyr::case_when( !is.finite( numeric_x ) ~ NA_character_, numeric_x <= 2 ~ "0-2 years", numeric_x <= 5 ~
          "3-5 years", numeric_x <= 10 ~ "6-10 years", numeric_x <= 15 ~ "11-15 years", TRUE ~ "16+ years" )
    }
    definition <- "0-2, 3-5, 6-10, 11-15 and 16+ vehicle-age bands."
  } else {
    reason <- paste0( "Unsupported segmentation rule type: ", rule_type )
  }
  if ( is.null( transform_function )
  ) {
    return( list( eligible = FALSE, segmentation_id = segmentation_id, segmentation_name = segmentation_name,
        segmentation_category = segmentation_category, source_variable = source_variable, rule_type = rule_type,
        rationale = rationale, definition = definition, reason = reason, transform = NULL ) )
  }
  validation_segments <- transform_function( validation_value )
  if ( anyNA( validation_segments ) || any( validation_segments == "" )
  ) {
    return( list( eligible = FALSE, segmentation_id = segmentation_id, segmentation_name = segmentation_name,
        segmentation_category = segmentation_category, source_variable = source_variable, rule_type = rule_type,
        rationale = rationale, definition = definition, reason =
          "Segmentation transformation produced missing validation labels.", transform = transform_function ) )
  }
  validation_counts <- table( validation_segments )
  if ( length( validation_counts ) < 2L
  ) {
    return( list( eligible = FALSE, segmentation_id = segmentation_id, segmentation_name = segmentation_name,
        segmentation_category = segmentation_category, source_variable = source_variable, rule_type = rule_type,
        rationale = rationale, definition = definition, reason =
          "Fewer than two validation segments are available.", transform = transform_function ) )
  }
  if ( min( validation_counts ) < config$minimum_targeted_segment_profiles
  ) {
    return( list( eligible = FALSE, segmentation_id = segmentation_id, segmentation_name = segmentation_name,
        segmentation_category = segmentation_category, source_variable = source_variable, rule_type = rule_type,
        rationale = rationale, definition = definition, reason = paste0(
            "At least one transformed validation segment has fewer than ",
            config$minimum_targeted_segment_profiles, " profiles." ), transform = transform_function ) )
  }
  list( eligible = TRUE, segmentation_id = segmentation_id, segmentation_name = segmentation_name,
    segmentation_category = segmentation_category, source_variable = source_variable, rule_type = rule_type,
    rationale = rationale, definition = definition, reason = NA_character_, transform = transform_function )
}
segmentation_specs <- purrr::pmap( segmentation_descriptors, function( segmentation_id, segmentation_name,
        segmentation_category, source_variable, rule_type, rationale
    ) {
      build_segmentation_spec( tibble( segmentation_id = segmentation_id, segmentation_name = segmentation_name,
          segmentation_category = segmentation_category, source_variable = source_variable, rule_type = rule_type,
          rationale = rationale ), validation_frame = validation_data )
    } )
targeted_segmentation_register <- purrr::map_dfr( segmentation_specs, function( specification
    ) {
      tibble( segmentation_id = specification$segmentation_id, segmentation_name = specification$segmentation_name,
        segmentation_category = specification$segmentation_category, source_variable =
          specification$source_variable, rule_type = specification$rule_type, eligible = isTRUE(
            specification$eligible ), definition = specification$definition, rationale = specification$rationale,
        exclusion_reason = specification$reason )
    } )
eligible_segmentation_specs <- purrr::keep( segmentation_specs, ~ isTRUE( .x$eligible ) )
if ( length( eligible_segmentation_specs ) < 2L
) {
  stop( "Fewer than two targeting segmentations are eligible for comparison." )
}
if ( !"age_band" %in% purrr::map_chr( eligible_segmentation_specs, "segmentation_id" )
) {
  stop( "The pre-specified age-band benchmark is not eligible for targeting comparison." )
}
omitted_targeting_candidates <- bind_rows( targeted_segmentation_register %>% filter( !eligible ) %>% transmute(
        candidate = segmentation_name, source_variable = source_variable, reason = exclusion_reason ), tibble(
      candidate = c( "Locality ID", "State x remoteness interaction", "Exact vehicle make/model" ),
      source_variable = c( "locality_id", "state x remoteness_area", "vehicle_make / vehicle_model" ), reason = c(
          "Deliberately excluded because the synthetic locality identifier is high-cardinality and would create sparse pricing cells.",
          "Deliberately excluded from the primary comparison to preserve the one-variable-at-a-time design and avoid sparse geographic interactions.",
          "Not retained in the frozen downstream modelling interface and too granular for a stable primary pricing-cell optimisation."
        ) ) ) %>% distinct()
validation_segmentation_membership <- purrr::map_dfr( eligible_segmentation_specs, function( specification
    ) {
      tibble( quote_profile_id = validation_data$quote_profile_id, segmentation_id = specification$segmentation_id,
        segmentation_name = specification$segmentation_name, segmentation_category =
          specification$segmentation_category, source_variable = specification$source_variable, pricing_segment =
          specification$transform( validation_data[[ specification$source_variable ]] ) )
    } )
# TEST segmentation membership is intentionally deferred until AFTER the
# validation-only targeting-basis selection. This prevents TEST covariate support
# from influencing which candidate segmentation is considered or selected.
targeted_segmentation_definitions <- validation_segmentation_membership %>% count( segmentation_id,
    segmentation_name, segmentation_category, source_variable, pricing_segment, name = "validation_profiles" ) %>%
  left_join( targeted_segmentation_register %>% dplyr::select( segmentation_id, rule_type, definition, rationale ),
    by = "segmentation_id" ) %>% arrange( segmentation_category, segmentation_name, pricing_segment )
```

```{r module-6-pricing-optimisation, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 14. COMMON DEVELOPMENT MULTIPLIER RESPONSE GRID
# Candidate-price predictions are computed only once for each multiplier. The
# same quote-level response surface is then aggregated under every targeting
# segmentation. This makes the comparison both computationally efficient and
# methodologically fair.
targeted_candidate_profiles <- purrr::map_dfr( multiplier_grid, function( multiplier
    ) {
      construct_candidate_data( base_data = validation_data, multiplier = multiplier ) %>%
        add_candidate_predictions( model_stage = "development" ) %>% mutate( candidate_multiplier = multiplier
        ) %>% dplyr::select( policy_id, quote_profile_id, candidate_multiplier, technical_premium, candidate_price,
          estimated_expected_claim_cost, focal_rank, relative_price_to_cheapest_competitor,
          relative_price_to_market_median, market_model_probability, market_model_expected_margin,
          market_model_expected_written_premium, market_model_expected_claim_cost )
    } )
build_segmentation_candidate_summary <- function( specification
) {
  membership <- validation_segmentation_membership %>% filter( segmentation_id == specification$segmentation_id
    ) %>% dplyr::select( quote_profile_id, segmentation_id, segmentation_name, segmentation_category,
      source_variable, pricing_segment )
  summary_table <- targeted_candidate_profiles %>% left_join( membership, by = "quote_profile_id" ) %>% group_by(
      segmentation_id, segmentation_name, segmentation_category, source_variable, pricing_segment,
      candidate_multiplier ) %>% summarise( profiles = n(), mean_estimated_claim_cost = mean(
          estimated_expected_claim_cost ), mean_technical_premium = mean( technical_premium ),
      mean_candidate_price = mean( candidate_price ), technical_premium_total = sum( technical_premium ),
      candidate_premium_total = sum( candidate_price ), segment_rate_level = safe_divide( candidate_premium_total,
          technical_premium_total ), model_expected_conversion_count = sum( market_model_probability ),
      model_expected_conversion_rate = mean( market_model_probability ), model_expected_underwriting_margin = sum(
          market_model_expected_margin ), model_expected_written_premium = sum(
          market_model_expected_written_premium ), model_expected_claim_cost = sum(
          market_model_expected_claim_cost ), model_expected_claim_ratio = safe_divide( model_expected_claim_cost,
          model_expected_written_premium ), mean_selected_rank = mean( focal_rank ), top_three_share = mean(
          focal_rank <= 3 ), mean_relative_price_to_cheapest = mean( relative_price_to_cheapest_competitor ),
      mean_relative_price_to_market_median = mean( relative_price_to_market_median ), .groups = "drop" )
  benchmark <- summary_table %>% filter( abs( candidate_multiplier - 1 ) < 1e-12 ) %>% transmute( segmentation_id,
      pricing_segment, benchmark_expected_margin = model_expected_underwriting_margin,
      benchmark_expected_conversion_count = model_expected_conversion_count, benchmark_expected_conversion_rate =
        model_expected_conversion_rate, benchmark_expected_written_premium = model_expected_written_premium,
      benchmark_expected_claim_cost = model_expected_claim_cost )
  summary_table %>% left_join( benchmark, by = c( "segmentation_id", "pricing_segment" ) ) %>% mutate(
      segment_margin_retention = safe_divide( model_expected_underwriting_margin, benchmark_expected_margin ),
      segment_conversion_retention = safe_divide( model_expected_conversion_count,
          benchmark_expected_conversion_count ), segment_conversion_uplift = model_expected_conversion_rate -
          benchmark_expected_conversion_rate, unit_margin_admissible = segment_margin_retention >=
          config$minimum_unit_margin_retention )
}
targeted_segmentation_candidate_summary <- purrr::map_dfr( eligible_segmentation_specs,
    build_segmentation_candidate_summary )
if ( anyNA( targeted_segmentation_candidate_summary$benchmark_expected_margin )
) {
  stop( "At least one targeting-segmentation benchmark could not be constructed." )
}
# Backward-compatible age-only diagnostic retained for the dissertation appendix
# and for comparison with the original Module 6 design.
targeted_age_candidate_summary <- targeted_segmentation_candidate_summary %>% filter( segmentation_id == "age_band"
  ) %>% mutate( pricing_age_band = pricing_segment, age_margin_retention = segment_margin_retention,
    age_conversion_retention = segment_conversion_retention )
```

```{r module-6-pricing-optimisation, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 15. COMMON COMMERCIAL FEASIBILITY AND SEGMENTATION-SPECIFIC OPTIMISATION
validation_technical_premium_total <- sum( validation_data$technical_premium )
validation_technical_model_margin <- development_technical_row$market_model_expected_underwriting_margin[ 1 ]
validation_technical_model_conversion_count <- development_technical_row$market_model_expected_new_business[ 1 ]
neutral_targeted_feasibility <- tibble( check_name = c( "Neutral rate level lower bound",
      "Neutral rate level upper bound", "Neutral portfolio margin retention", "Neutral conversion retention",
      "Neutral expected claim-ratio ceiling" ), value = c( development_technical_row$aggregate_rate_level[ 1 ],
      development_technical_row$aggregate_rate_level[ 1 ], 1, 1,
      development_technical_row$market_model_claim_ratio[ 1 ] ), required = c( config$targeted_rate_level_lower,
      config$targeted_rate_level_upper, config$minimum_portfolio_margin_retention,
      config$minimum_targeted_conversion_retention, config$maximum_admissible_claim_ratio ), direction = c( ">=",
      "<=", ">=", ">=", "<=" ) ) %>% mutate( pass = case_when( direction == ">=" ~ value >= required - 1e-10,
        direction == "<=" ~ value <= required + 1e-10, TRUE ~ FALSE ) )
if ( !all( neutral_targeted_feasibility$pass )
) {
  print( neutral_targeted_feasibility, n = Inf )
  stop( paste( "The neutral targeted strategy is not feasible under the requested",
      "commercial constraints. The sensitivity case therefore represents",
      "genuine infeasibility rather than a segmentation-solver issue." ) )
}
solve_targeted_segmentation <- function( specification
) {
  segmentation_id <- specification$segmentation_id
  candidate_summary <- targeted_segmentation_candidate_summary %>% filter( .data$segmentation_id ==
        !!segmentation_id )
  segment_levels <- validation_segmentation_membership %>% filter( .data$segmentation_id == !!segmentation_id ) %>%
    distinct( pricing_segment ) %>% arrange( pricing_segment ) %>% pull( pricing_segment )
  lp_options <- candidate_summary %>% filter( unit_margin_admissible ) %>% arrange( pricing_segment,
      candidate_multiplier ) %>% mutate( lp_variable_id = row_number() )
  option_segment_levels <- sort( unique( lp_options$pricing_segment ) )
  if ( !setequal( segment_levels, option_segment_levels )
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "At least one segment has no admissible multiplier for segmentation: ", segmentation_id ) )
  }
  neutral_options <- lp_options %>% filter( abs( candidate_multiplier - 1 ) < 1e-12 )
  if ( nrow( neutral_options ) != length( segment_levels )
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Neutral 1.00 option missing for at least one segment in segmentation: ", segmentation_id ) )
  }
  constraint_rows <- list()
  constraint_directions <- character()
  constraint_rhs <- numeric()
  for ( segment_level in segment_levels
  ) {
    constraint_rows[[ length( constraint_rows ) + 1L ]] <- as.numeric( lp_options$pricing_segment == segment_level
      )
    constraint_directions <- c( constraint_directions, "=" )
    constraint_rhs <- c( constraint_rhs, 1 )
  }
  # Aggregate rate-level lower bound.
  constraint_rows[[ length( constraint_rows ) + 1L ]] <- lp_options$candidate_premium_total /
      validation_technical_premium_total
  constraint_directions <- c( constraint_directions, ">=" )
  constraint_rhs <- c( constraint_rhs, config$targeted_rate_level_lower )
  # Aggregate rate-level upper bound.
  constraint_rows[[ length( constraint_rows ) + 1L ]] <- lp_options$candidate_premium_total /
      validation_technical_premium_total
  constraint_directions <- c( constraint_directions, "<=" )
  constraint_rhs <- c( constraint_rhs, config$targeted_rate_level_upper )
  # Portfolio model-expected margin preservation.
  constraint_rows[[ length( constraint_rows ) + 1L ]] <- lp_options$model_expected_underwriting_margin /
      validation_technical_model_margin
  constraint_directions <- c( constraint_directions, ">=" )
  constraint_rhs <- c( constraint_rhs, config$minimum_portfolio_margin_retention )
  # Portfolio conversion retention.
  constraint_rows[[ length( constraint_rows ) + 1L ]] <- lp_options$model_expected_conversion_count /
      validation_technical_model_conversion_count
  constraint_directions <- c( constraint_directions, ">=" )
  constraint_rhs <- c( constraint_rhs, config$minimum_targeted_conversion_retention )
  # Expected claim-ratio ceiling.
  constraint_rows[[ length( constraint_rows ) + 1L ]] <- ( lp_options$model_expected_claim_cost -
        config$maximum_admissible_claim_ratio * lp_options$model_expected_written_premium ) /
      validation_technical_premium_total
  constraint_directions <- c( constraint_directions, "<=" )
  constraint_rhs <- c( constraint_rhs, 0 )
  constraint_matrix <- do.call( rbind, constraint_rows )
  lp_solution <- lpSolve::lp( direction = "max", objective.in = lp_options$model_expected_conversion_count /
          validation_technical_model_conversion_count, const.mat = constraint_matrix, const.dir =
        constraint_directions, const.rhs = constraint_rhs, all.bin = TRUE )
  if ( lp_solution$status != 0L
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Targeted optimisation failed for segmentation '", segmentation_id,
        "' after neutral feasibility had been verified. lpSolve status = ", lp_solution$status, "." ) )
  }
  selected_rows <- which( lp_solution$solution > 0.5 )
  selected_options <- lp_options[ selected_rows, ] %>% arrange( pricing_segment )
  if ( nrow( selected_options ) != length( segment_levels )
  ) {
    stop( paste0( "Targeted optimisation did not select exactly one multiplier per segment for ", segmentation_id,
        "." ) )
  }
  selected_metrics <- candidate_summary %>% inner_join( selected_options %>% dplyr::select( pricing_segment,
          selected_multiplier = candidate_multiplier ), by = "pricing_segment" ) %>% filter( abs(
        candidate_multiplier - selected_multiplier ) < 1e-12 )
  total_candidate_premium <- sum( selected_metrics$candidate_premium_total )
  total_model_margin <- sum( selected_metrics$model_expected_underwriting_margin )
  total_conversion_count <- sum( selected_metrics$model_expected_conversion_count )
  total_written_premium <- sum( selected_metrics$model_expected_written_premium )
  total_claim_cost <- sum( selected_metrics$model_expected_claim_cost )
  selected_multiplier_table <- selected_metrics %>% transmute( segmentation_id, segmentation_name,
      segmentation_category, source_variable, pricing_segment, selected_multiplier = candidate_multiplier,
      development_profiles = profiles, development_mean_estimated_claim_cost = mean_estimated_claim_cost,
      development_mean_technical_premium = mean_technical_premium, development_model_expected_conversion_rate =
        model_expected_conversion_rate, development_model_expected_underwriting_margin =
        model_expected_underwriting_margin, development_model_expected_claim_ratio = model_expected_claim_ratio,
      development_segment_margin_retention = segment_margin_retention, development_segment_conversion_retention =
        segment_conversion_retention, development_mean_selected_rank = mean_selected_rank,
      development_top_three_share = top_three_share )
  selection_summary <- tibble( segmentation_id = segmentation_id, segmentation_name =
        specification$segmentation_name, segmentation_category = specification$segmentation_category,
      source_variable = specification$source_variable, number_segments = length( segment_levels ),
      minimum_validation_segment_profiles = min( selected_metrics$profiles ), selected_rate_level = safe_divide(
          total_candidate_premium, validation_technical_premium_total ), selected_portfolio_margin_retention =
        safe_divide( total_model_margin, validation_technical_model_margin ),
      selected_minimum_segment_margin_retention = min( selected_metrics$segment_margin_retention ),
      selected_model_expected_conversion_rate = safe_divide( total_conversion_count, nrow( validation_data ) ),
      technical_model_expected_conversion_rate = development_technical_row$market_model_expected_conversion_rate[ 1
        ], selected_model_conversion_retention = safe_divide( total_conversion_count,
          validation_technical_model_conversion_count ), selected_model_expected_underwriting_margin =
        total_model_margin, technical_model_expected_underwriting_margin = validation_technical_model_margin,
      selected_model_expected_claim_ratio = safe_divide( total_claim_cost, total_written_premium ),
      selected_multiplier_min = min( selected_multiplier_table$selected_multiplier ), selected_multiplier_max =
        max( selected_multiplier_table$selected_multiplier ), selected_multiplier_mean = mean(
          selected_multiplier_table$selected_multiplier ), selected_distinct_multipliers = n_distinct(
          selected_multiplier_table$selected_multiplier ) )
  list( multipliers = selected_multiplier_table, summary = selection_summary )
}
targeted_segmentation_solutions <- purrr::map( eligible_segmentation_specs, solve_targeted_segmentation )
all_targeted_segmentation_multipliers <- purrr::map_dfr( targeted_segmentation_solutions, "multipliers" )
targeted_segmentation_comparison <- purrr::map_dfr( targeted_segmentation_solutions, "summary" ) %>% mutate(
    validation_conversion_uplift = selected_model_expected_conversion_rate -
        technical_model_expected_conversion_rate, validation_relative_conversion_uplift =
      selected_model_conversion_retention - 1, validation_rank = min_rank( desc(
          selected_model_expected_conversion_rate ) ) )
best_validation_conversion_rate <- max( targeted_segmentation_comparison$selected_model_expected_conversion_rate )
targeted_segmentation_comparison <- targeted_segmentation_comparison %>% mutate( within_selection_tolerance =
      selected_model_expected_conversion_rate >= best_validation_conversion_rate -
          config$targeted_segmentation_selection_tolerance )
selected_segmentation_row <- targeted_segmentation_comparison %>% filter( within_selection_tolerance ) %>% arrange(
    number_segments, desc( selected_model_expected_conversion_rate ), desc( selected_portfolio_margin_retention ),
    segmentation_id ) %>% slice( 1 )
selected_segmentation_id <- selected_segmentation_row$segmentation_id[ 1 ]
selected_segmentation_name <- selected_segmentation_row$segmentation_name[ 1 ]
selected_segmentation_category <- selected_segmentation_row$segmentation_category[ 1 ]
selected_segmentation_source_variable <- selected_segmentation_row$source_variable[ 1 ]
selected_segmentation_spec <- eligible_segmentation_specs[[ which( purrr::map_chr( eligible_segmentation_specs,
        "segmentation_id" ) == selected_segmentation_id )[ 1 ] ]]
targeted_segmentation_comparison <- targeted_segmentation_comparison %>% mutate( selected_for_test =
      segmentation_id == selected_segmentation_id ) %>% arrange( validation_rank, number_segments )
targeting_segment_risk_response_summary <- targeted_segmentation_candidate_summary %>% filter( abs(
      candidate_multiplier - 1 ) < 1e-12 ) %>% dplyr::select( segmentation_id, segmentation_name,
    segmentation_category, source_variable, pricing_segment, profiles, mean_estimated_claim_cost,
    mean_technical_premium, baseline_model_expected_conversion_rate = model_expected_conversion_rate,
    baseline_model_expected_claim_ratio = model_expected_claim_ratio, baseline_mean_rank = mean_selected_rank,
    baseline_relative_price_to_cheapest = mean_relative_price_to_cheapest,
    baseline_relative_price_to_market_median = mean_relative_price_to_market_median ) %>% mutate(
    estimated_claim_cost_index = safe_divide( mean_estimated_claim_cost, mean(
          validation_data$estimated_expected_claim_cost ) ), technical_premium_index = safe_divide(
        mean_technical_premium, mean( validation_data$technical_premium ) ) ) %>% left_join(
    all_targeted_segmentation_multipliers %>% dplyr::select( segmentation_id, pricing_segment, selected_multiplier,
        selected_model_expected_conversion_rate = development_model_expected_conversion_rate,
        selected_model_expected_claim_ratio = development_model_expected_claim_ratio, segment_margin_retention =
          development_segment_margin_retention, segment_conversion_retention =
          development_segment_conversion_retention, selected_mean_rank = development_mean_selected_rank,
        selected_top_three_share = development_top_three_share ), by = c( "segmentation_id", "pricing_segment" )
  ) %>% left_join( targeted_segmentation_comparison %>% dplyr::select( segmentation_id, validation_rank,
        selected_for_test ), by = "segmentation_id" ) %>% arrange( validation_rank, segmentation_name,
    pricing_segment )
selected_segment_multipliers <- all_targeted_segmentation_multipliers %>% filter( segmentation_id ==
      selected_segmentation_id ) %>% mutate(
    # Backward-compatible aliases retained for Module 7/8 collectors. These
    # columns should not be interpreted as literal age bands unless age_band is
    # the selected targeting basis.
    pricing_age_band = if_else( segmentation_id == "age_band", pricing_segment, NA_character_ ),
    development_age_margin_retention = development_segment_margin_retention, development_age_conversion_retention =
      development_segment_conversion_retention ) %>% relocate( pricing_age_band, .after = pricing_segment )
age_segmentation_summary <- targeted_segmentation_comparison %>% filter( segmentation_id == "age_band" )
if ( nrow( age_segmentation_summary ) != 1L
) {
  stop( "Exactly one age-band targeting benchmark must be present." )
}
```

```{r module-6-pricing-optimisation, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
targeted_strategy_selection_summary <- selected_segmentation_row %>% transmute( selected_segmentation_id =
      segmentation_id, selected_segmentation_name = segmentation_name, selected_segmentation_category =
      segmentation_category, selected_source_variable = source_variable, selected_validation_rank =
```

```{r module-6-pricing-optimisation, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
# 21. TRUE COUNTERFACTUAL CONVERSION FUNCTION
evaluate_true_counterfactual <- function( candidate_profile_data
) {
  candidate_profile_prices <- candidate_profile_data %>% dplyr::select( policy_id, quote_profile_id,
      candidate_price, estimated_expected_claim_cost )
  profile_truth_for_candidate <- truth_test_profiles %>% dplyr::select( policy_id, quote_profile_id, driver_age,
      prior_claims_5yr, true_choice_price_sensitivity ) %>% inner_join( candidate_profile_prices, by = c(
        "policy_id", "quote_profile_id" ) )
  alternative_counterfactual <- truth_test_alternatives %>% dplyr::select( policy_id, quote_profile_id,
      alternative_id, alternative_archetype, is_focal, alternative_quote, base_nonprice_utility,
      latent_taste_utility ) %>% inner_join( profile_truth_for_candidate %>% dplyr::select( policy_id,
          quote_profile_id, true_choice_price_sensitivity, candidate_price ), by = c( "policy_id",
        "quote_profile_id" ) ) %>% mutate( counterfactual_quote = if_else( is_focal, candidate_price,
          alternative_quote ) ) %>% group_by( policy_id, quote_profile_id ) %>% mutate(
      counterfactual_cheapest_quote = min( counterfactual_quote ), counterfactual_market_median = median(
          counterfactual_quote ), counterfactual_rank = rank( counterfactual_quote, ties.method = "first" ),
      counterfactual_relative_price = safe_divide( counterfactual_quote, counterfactual_cheapest_quote ),
      smooth_price_utility = -true_choice_price_sensitivity * log( counterfactual_relative_price ),
      rank_salience_utility = rank_salience_scale * case_when( counterfactual_rank == 1 ~ 0.55,
            counterfactual_rank == 2 ~ 0.26, counterfactual_rank == 3 ~ 0.10, TRUE ~ 0 ), price_threshold_excess =
        pmax( counterfactual_relative_price - price_threshold_ratio, 0 ), price_threshold_penalty =
        price_threshold_strength * ( price_threshold_excess / 0.05 )^2, rank_threshold_excess = pmax(
          counterfactual_rank - rank_threshold, 0 ), rank_threshold_penalty = rank_threshold_strength *
          rank_threshold_excess^2, counterfactual_true_utility = base_nonprice_utility + latent_taste_utility +
        smooth_price_utility + rank_salience_utility - price_threshold_penalty - rank_threshold_penalty + if_else(
          is_focal, focal_brand_constant, 0 ), utility_maximum = max( counterfactual_true_utility ),
      choice_numerator = exp( counterfactual_true_utility - utility_maximum ),
      true_conditional_choice_probability = choice_numerator / sum( choice_numerator ) ) %>% ungroup()
  focal_choice_truth <- alternative_counterfactual %>% filter( is_focal ) %>% transmute( policy_id,
      quote_profile_id, true_counterfactual_focal_rank = counterfactual_rank, true_counterfactual_market_median =
        counterfactual_market_median, true_counterfactual_focal_choice_probability =
        true_conditional_choice_probability )
  profile_truth_counterfactual <- profile_truth_for_candidate %>% left_join( focal_choice_truth, by = c(
        "policy_id", "quote_profile_id" ) ) %>% mutate( participation_market_price_index = log(
          true_counterfactual_market_median / portfolio_market_median ), participation_age_effect = case_when(
          driver_age <= 24 ~ -0.12, driver_age <= 34 ~ 0.02, driver_age <= 69 ~ 0.10, driver_age <= 79 ~ 0.02,
          TRUE ~ -0.06 ), participation_claim_history_effect = 0.035 * pmin( prior_claims_5yr, 3 ),
      true_counterfactual_market_purchase_probability = clip_probability( plogis( participation_intercept -
              participation_market_price_sensitivity * participation_market_price_index +
              participation_age_effect + participation_claim_history_effect ) ),
      true_counterfactual_focal_conversion_probability = true_counterfactual_market_purchase_probability *
          true_counterfactual_focal_choice_probability, true_counterfactual_expected_margin =
        true_counterfactual_focal_conversion_probability * ( candidate_price - estimated_expected_claim_cost ),
      true_counterfactual_expected_written_premium = true_counterfactual_focal_conversion_probability *
          candidate_price, true_counterfactual_expected_claim_cost =
        true_counterfactual_focal_conversion_probability * estimated_expected_claim_cost )
  if ( nrow( profile_truth_counterfactual ) != nrow( candidate_profile_data ) || any( !is.finite(
          profile_truth_counterfactual$true_counterfactual_focal_conversion_probability ) )
  ) {
    stop( "True counterfactual conversion reconstruction failed." )
  }
  profile_truth_counterfactual
}
```

```{r module-6-pricing-optimisation, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
    targeted_segmentation_comparison$segmentation_id, "Exactly one targeting basis selected for TEST", sum(
    targeted_segmentation_comparison$selected_for_test ), 1, 1, sum(
    targeted_segmentation_comparison$selected_for_test ) == 1,
  "Selected targeting basis uses validation-defined segments on all TEST rows", nrow( selected_test_membership ),
  nrow( test_data ), nrow( test_data ), nrow( selected_test_membership ) == nrow( test_data ) && !anyNA(
        selected_test_membership$pricing_segment ),
  "Selected targeting basis has sufficient validation profiles per segment", min(
    selected_validation_segment_counts$profiles ), config$minimum_targeted_segment_profiles, Inf, min(
    selected_validation_segment_counts$profiles ) >= config$minimum_targeted_segment_profiles,
  "Technical benchmark multiplier", technical_test_row$mean_multiplier[ 1 ], 1, 1, abs(
    technical_test_row$mean_multiplier[ 1 ] - 1 ) < 1e-12, "Own-price selected multiplier inside support",
  selected_own_price_uniform$multiplier[ 1 ], config$multiplier_lower, config$multiplier_upper,
  selected_own_price_uniform$multiplier[ 1 ] >= config$multiplier_lower && selected_own_price_uniform$multiplier[ 1
  ] <= config$multiplier_upper, "Market-uniform selected multiplier inside support",
  selected_market_uniform$multiplier[ 1 ], config$multiplier_lower, config$multiplier_upper,
  selected_market_uniform$multiplier[ 1 ] >= config$multiplier_lower && selected_market_uniform$multiplier[ 1 ] <=
    config$multiplier_upper, "Targeted multipliers inside support", mean(
    selected_segment_multipliers$selected_multiplier >= config$multiplier_lower &
      selected_segment_multipliers$selected_multiplier <= config$multiplier_upper ), 1, 1, all(
    selected_segment_multipliers$selected_multiplier >= config$multiplier_lower &
      selected_segment_multipliers$selected_multiplier <= config$multiplier_upper ),
  "Exactly one targeted multiplier per selected segment", nrow( selected_segment_multipliers ),
  selected_number_segments, selected_number_segments, nrow( selected_segment_multipliers ) ==
    selected_number_segments && n_distinct( selected_segment_multipliers$pricing_segment ) ==
        selected_number_segments, "Targeted development rate level",
  targeted_strategy_selection_summary$selected_rate_level[ 1 ], config$targeted_rate_level_lower,
  config$targeted_rate_level_upper, targeted_strategy_selection_summary$selected_rate_level[ 1 ] >=
    config$targeted_rate_level_lower && targeted_strategy_selection_summary$selected_rate_level[ 1 ] <=
    config$targeted_rate_level_upper, "Targeted development portfolio margin retention",
  targeted_strategy_selection_summary$selected_portfolio_margin_retention[ 1 ],
  config$minimum_portfolio_margin_retention, Inf,
  targeted_strategy_selection_summary$selected_portfolio_margin_retention[ 1 ] >=
    config$minimum_portfolio_margin_retention, "Targeted minimum selected-segment margin retention",
  targeted_strategy_selection_summary$selected_minimum_segment_margin_retention[ 1 ],
  config$minimum_unit_margin_retention, Inf,
  targeted_strategy_selection_summary$selected_minimum_segment_margin_retention[ 1 ] >=
    config$minimum_unit_margin_retention, "Targeted development expected claim ratio",
  targeted_strategy_selection_summary$selected_model_expected_claim_ratio[ 1 ], 0,
  config$maximum_admissible_claim_ratio, targeted_strategy_selection_summary$selected_model_expected_claim_ratio[ 1
  ] <= config$maximum_admissible_claim_ratio, "Targeted development conversion retention",
  targeted_strategy_selection_summary$selected_model_conversion_retention[ 1 ],
  config$minimum_targeted_conversion_retention, Inf,
  targeted_strategy_selection_summary$selected_model_conversion_retention[ 1 ] >=
    config$minimum_targeted_conversion_retention - 1e-10, "All TEST strategy true probabilities finite", mean(
    is.finite( test_strategy_profile_results$true_counterfactual_focal_conversion_probability ) ), 1, 1, all(
    is.finite( test_strategy_profile_results$true_counterfactual_focal_conversion_probability ) ),
  "All TEST strategy fitted probabilities finite", mean( is.finite(
      test_strategy_profile_results$market_model_probability ) & is.finite(
        test_strategy_profile_results$own_price_model_probability ) ), 1, 1, all( is.finite(
      test_strategy_profile_results$market_model_probability ) & is.finite(
        test_strategy_profile_results$own_price_model_probability ) ), "Four required TEST strategies produced",
  nrow( test_strategy_comparison ), 4, 4, nrow( test_strategy_comparison ) == 4 )
# Recompute all numerical validation decisions from their reported bounds using
# one consistent floating-point tolerance. This prevents values such as
# 0.999999999999999 from failing a 1.00 boundary while preserving the stated
# commercial constraint itself.
pricing_validation_checks <- pricing_validation_checks %>% mutate( numerical_tolerance = 1e-10 * pmax( 1, abs(
            observed_value ), if_else( is.finite( lower_bound ), abs( lower_bound ), 0 ), if_else( is.finite(
              upper_bound ), abs( upper_bound ), 0 ) ), pass = is.finite( observed_value ) & ( !is.finite(
            lower_bound ) | observed_value >= lower_bound - numerical_tolerance ) & ( !is.finite( upper_bound ) |
            observed_value <= upper_bound + numerical_tolerance ) ) %>% dplyr::select( -numerical_tolerance )
if ( any( !pricing_validation_checks$pass )
) {
  failed_pricing_checks <- pricing_validation_checks %>% filter( !pass ) %>% pull( check_name )
  readr::write_csv( pricing_validation_checks, file.path( config$output_dir, "pricing_validation_checks.csv" ) )
  stop( paste0( "Module 6 pricing validation failed: ", paste( failed_pricing_checks, collapse = "; " ) ) )
}
```
